summary: Restricted access request: grant time-bound read access to raw audit logs for incident investigation (Audit Log Exporter delivery lag)
description:
Issue summary
Request restricted access to raw audit log records (pre-redaction, non-exported internal store) to support investigation of audit-log exporter backlog / delivery lag impacting enterprise export reliability.

Requester
- Rafael Mendes (SRE) on behalf of Incident Commander / SRE on-call

Business justification
- Investigate whether delivery lag is caused by exporter sink failures vs upstream ingest/validation vs storage lag.
- Need to correlate specific customer export failures with pipeline enqueue/persist/export timestamps and error payloads not surfaced in standard dashboards.

Requested access
- Resource: Audit Log Raw Store (internal), dataset: auditlog_raw_prod
- Access level: Read-only, query-only (no write, no delete), no ability to change retention/export configs
- Scope: Narrowed to time window 2025-06-08 00:00 UTC through 2025-06-10 23:59 UTC and to exporter-related fields only (delivery status, sink type, exporter error code, request_id correlation)

Data sensitivity notes
Raw audit logs may contain IP address and user agent and may include unredacted payload fields prior to enforcement of newest redaction rules. Requester acknowledges:
- No copying of raw data to external systems
- No sharing in Slack; only paste request_id/event_id references, not payloads
- Use only approved incident channel artifacts and Confluence post-incident notes

Approvals required (per policy)
- Security Engineering approval (Marcus Lin)
- GRC/Compliance notify when access is granted for audit trail (Olga Petrov)
- Time-bound access with explicit expiration and confirmation of query audit logging enabled

Requested duration
- 72 hours, with automatic expiration. Can be extended via new ticket if still needed.

Acceptance criteria
- Access granted to Rafael Mendes via restricted group with read-only permissions
- Confirm query audit logging is enabled and retained
- Access revokes automatically at expiration; revocation confirmed in comments

Notes
This ticket is internal-only. Do not reference customer names in raw-log queries; use internal request_id/event_id and exporter sink identifiers.
comments: 2025-06-09 09:14 - Rafael Mendes (Reporter): Creating this access request per audit-log-access-policy. We’re actively investigating exporter backlog and need raw-store visibility beyond Grafana metrics. Proposed scope/time window in description. Please advise on required approvals and the correct group to request.

2025-06-09 10:02 - Marcus Lin (Assignee, Security Eng): Acknowledged. Per policy, I can approve time-bound read-only access if (1) least-privilege scope is enforced, (2) query audit logging is confirmed, and (3) we notify GRC for evidence. Please confirm exact dataset name + whether this includes payload.body fields. Payload access should be restricted unless absolutely required.

2025-06-09 10:18 - Rafael Mendes: Dataset is auditlog_raw_prod in the internal warehouse. We do NOT need payload bodies; we need delivery pipeline metadata (event_id, request_id, org_id hash, sink, exporter status, exporter_error_code, timestamps: enqueued_at/persisted_at/exported_at). Happy to proceed with a view or column-restricted role if available.

2025-06-09 11:07 - Olga Petrov (GRC): Thanks for looping me in. Please ensure the access grant is logged (who/what/when/why), includes an expiration date, and that query logs are retained per standard. No additional GRC approval needed if Security Eng approves and scope is metadata-only.

2025-06-09 12:26 - Marcus Lin: Approved with conditions: (a) grant via column-restricted view (no payload), (b) read-only role, (c) 72-hour expiry, (d) queries must be tied to incident ID INC-2025-06-09-auditlog-exporter-backlog in the query comment/tag field if supported. Assigning to AccessOps to execute.

2025-06-09 13:03 - Nadia Rahman (Platform/Telemetry): Implemented via role sec_auditlog_raw_incident_ro with access to view auditlog_raw_prod.v_exporter_delivery_metadata only. Granted to Rafael Mendes. Expiration set for 2025-06-12 13:00 PT (auto-revoke job). Query audit logging is enabled at the warehouse level; tags/notes supported via /* incident: INC-2025-06-09-auditlog-exporter-backlog */ in query text.
2025-06-09 13:17 - Rafael Mendes: Confirmed access works. I can query v_exporter_delivery_metadata and pull request_id/event_id timelines without payload fields. Thank you.

2025-06-11 16:42 - Marcus Lin: Reminder: access auto-revokes on 2025-06-12 13:00 PT. If investigation extends, file a new ticket with updated scope. Please ensure any findings shared externally reference only metrics and IDs, not raw row contents.

2025-06-11 17:10 - Nadia Rahman: Closing out early — exporter fix is rolling out and investigation is complete. Manual revoke executed for Rafael Mendes (removed from sec_auditlog_raw_incident_ro grants). Will still allow auto-revoke job to run as a no-op tomorrow.
resolution: Approved and granted time-bound, least-privilege read-only access to a column-restricted view of raw audit log delivery metadata for incident investigation. Access was manually revoked after investigation completed; query audit logging remained enabled throughout.
